chapterInfo.content:
2
Kristo yɛ Ɔkamafoɔ
1 # Rom 8.34; Heb 7.25 Me mma nkumaa, meretwerɛ yeinom mabrɛ mo, na moanyɛ bɔne. Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a, yɛwɔ ɔkamafoɔ bi, Agya no nkyɛn, ɔno ne Ɔteneneeni Yesu Kristo. 2#Kol 1.20 Na ɔno ne yɛn bɔne ho mpata, na ɛnyɛ yɛn deɛ ho nko, na mmom wiase nyinaa deɛ ho bi.
3Na sɛ yɛdi n’ahyɛdeɛ so a, ɛno ara na yɛde hunu sɛ yɛnim no. 4Deɛ ɔka sɛ: Menim no, na ɔnni n’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ no, yɛ ɔtorofoɔ, na nokorɛ no nni ne mu. 5#Yoh 14.21; 14.23 Na obiara a ɔdi n’asɛm soɔ no, ampa ara, ɔno mu na Nyankopɔn dɔ no awie pɛyɛ. Yei na yɛde hunu sɛ yɛwɔ ne mu. 6#Yoh 13.15 Deɛ ɔka sɛ ɔte ne mu no, ɛsɛ no sɛ ɔnante sɛdeɛ ɔno nso nanteeɛ.
Ahyɛdeɛ foforɔ
7 # Yoh 13.34 Adɔfo, ɛnyɛ ahyɛdeɛ foforɔ na meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo, na mmom ahyɛdeɛ dada a moanya firi mfitiaseɛ no. Ahyɛdeɛ dada no ne asɛm a moateɛ no. 8#Rom 13.12 Nso meretwerɛ ahyɛdeɛ foforɔ mabrɛ mo a ɛyɛ nokorɛ wɔ ɔno ne mo mu: Sɛ esum retwa mu, na nokorɛ hann no anya rehyerɛn. 9#1 Yoh 4.20 Deɛ ɔka sɛ ɔwɔ hann no mu na ɔtane ne nua no, ɔda so wɔ sum mu ara de bɛsi sɛsɛɛ. 10Deɛ ɔdɔ ne nua no wɔ hann no mu, na suntidua nni ne mu. 11Na deɛ ɔtan ne nua no te sum mu na ɔnam sum mu, na ɔnnim deɛ ɔrekorɔ, ɛfiri sɛ esum no afira n’ani.
12Mma nkumaa, meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
ne din nti wɔde mo bɔne akyɛ mo.
13Agyanom, meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo
ɛfiri sɛ monim deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ firi mfitiaseɛ no.
Mmeranteɛ, meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
moadi ɔbɔnefoɔ no so nkonim.
Mmɔfra nkumaa, matwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
monim Agya no.
14 # Efe 6.10 Agyanom, matwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
monim deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ firi mfitiaseɛ no.
Mmeranteɛ, matwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
mo ho yɛ den,
na Nyankopɔn asɛm no te mo mu,
na moadi ɔbɔnefoɔ no so nkonim.
Wiase dɔ ne Nyankopɔn dɔ
15 # Yak 4.4 Monnnɔ wiase anaa nnoɔma a ɛwɔ wiase. Sɛ obi dɔ wiase a, Agya no dɔ no nni ne mu. 16Na deɛ ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa, honam akɔnnɔ ne aniwa akɔnnɔ ne asetena mu ahohoahoa, ɛmfiri Agya no, na mmom ɛfiri wiase. 17Na wiase ne n’akɔnnɔ retwam, na deɛ ɔyɛ adeɛ a Onyankopɔn pɛ no tena hɔ daa.
Antikristo no ho kɔkɔbɔ
18 # Mat 24.5; 24.24 Mmɔfra nkumaa, ɛdɔn a ɛdi akyire nie. Na sɛdeɛ moate sɛ antikristo no rebɛba no, saa na seesei yi antikristo bebree aba; ɛnna yɛde hunu sɛ dɔn a ɛdi akyire nie. 19#Aso 20.30 Wɔfiri yɛn mu na ɛkɔeɛ deɛ, nanso wɔnka yɛn ho, na sɛ wɔka yɛn ho a, anka wɔne yɛn tenaa hɔ. Na ɛyɛɛ saa na wɔada adi sɛ wɔn nyinaa nka yɛn ho. 20#1 Yoh 2.27 Na mo deɛ, moanya ngosra no firi Ɔkronkronni no hɔ, na mo nyinaa nim de. 21Mantwerɛ mammrɛ mo sɛdeɛ monnim nokorɛ no, na mmom sɛ monim, ne sɛ atorɔ biara mfiri nokorɛ no mu.
22Hwan ne ɔtorofoɔ no sɛ deɛ ɔsane sɛ Yesu nyɛ Kristo no? Oyi ne antikristo a ɔpo Agya no ne Ɔba no. 23#1 Yoh 4.15; Yoh 5.23 Obiara a ɔpo Ɔba no, ɔnni Agya no nso, na deɛ ɔpae mu bɔ Ɔba no din no, wɔ Agya no nso. 24#1 Yoh 2.7 Enti mo deɛ, deɛ mote firii mfitiaseɛ no, momma no ntena mo mu; na sɛ deɛ mote firii mfitiaseɛ no tena mo mu a, ɛnneɛ mo nso mobɛtena Ɔba no ne Agya no mu. 25Na ɛbɔ a ɔde ahyɛ yɛn ne daa nkwa no.
26Deɛ matwerɛ mabrɛ mo yi fa wɔn a wɔdaadaa mo no ho. 27#1 Yoh 2.20; Yoh 16.13 Na mo deɛ, ngosra a monyaa no ne nsa mu no te mo mu, enti ɛnhia mo sɛ obi kyerɛkyerɛ mo; na mmom sɛdeɛ ngosra no ara kyerɛkyerɛ mo ade nyinaa ho no na ɛyɛ nokorɛ, na ɛnyɛ atorɔ. Na sɛdeɛ akyerɛkyerɛ mo no, montena ne mu! 28#1 Yoh 4.17 Na afei, mma nkumaa, montena ne mu, na sɛ oyi ne ho adi a, yɛanya awerɛhyɛmu, na yɛn ani anwu n’anim, ne ba mu.
Nyankopɔn mma
29 # 1 Yoh 3.7; 3.10 Sɛ monim sɛ ɔyɛ ɔteneneeni a, anka mobɛhunu sɛ obiara a ɔyɛ ade tenenee no, ɔno na Onyankopɔn awo no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Me mma nkumaa, meretwerɛ yeinom mabrɛ mo, na moanyɛ bɔne. Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a, yɛwɔ ɔkamafoɔ bi, Agya no nkyɛn, ɔno ne Ɔteneneeni Yesu Kristo. Na ɔno ne yɛn bɔne ho mpata, na ɛnyɛ yɛn deɛ ho nko, na mmom wiase nyinaa deɛ ho bi.
Na sɛ yɛdi n’ahyɛdeɛ so a, ɛno ara na yɛde hunu sɛ yɛnim no. Deɛ ɔka sɛ: Menim no, na ɔnni n’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ no, yɛ ɔtorofoɔ, na nokorɛ no nni ne mu. Na obiara a ɔdi n’asɛm soɔ no, ampa ara, ɔno mu na Nyankopɔn dɔ no awie pɛyɛ. Yei na yɛde hunu sɛ yɛwɔ ne mu. Deɛ ɔka sɛ ɔte ne mu no, ɛsɛ no sɛ ɔnante sɛdeɛ ɔno nso nanteeɛ.

Adɔfo, ɛnyɛ ahyɛdeɛ foforɔ na meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo, na mmom ahyɛdeɛ dada a moanya firi mfitiaseɛ no. Ahyɛdeɛ dada no ne asɛm a moateɛ no. Nso meretwerɛ ahyɛdeɛ foforɔ mabrɛ mo a ɛyɛ nokorɛ wɔ ɔno ne mo mu: Sɛ esum retwa mu, na nokorɛ hann no anya rehyerɛn. Deɛ ɔka sɛ ɔwɔ hann no mu na ɔtane ne nua no, ɔda so wɔ sum mu ara de bɛsi sɛsɛɛ. Deɛ ɔdɔ ne nua no wɔ hann no mu, na suntidua nni ne mu. Na deɛ ɔtan ne nua no te sum mu na ɔnam sum mu, na ɔnnim deɛ ɔrekorɔ, ɛfiri sɛ esum no afira n’ani.
Mma nkumaa, meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
ne din nti wɔde mo bɔne akyɛ mo.
Agyanom, meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo
ɛfiri sɛ monim deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ firi mfitiaseɛ no.
Mmeranteɛ, meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
moadi ɔbɔnefoɔ no so nkonim.
Mmɔfra nkumaa, matwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
monim Agya no.
Agyanom, matwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
monim deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ firi mfitiaseɛ no.
Mmeranteɛ, matwerɛ mabrɛ mo sɛ,
mo ho yɛ den,
na Nyankopɔn asɛm no te mo mu,
na moadi ɔbɔnefoɔ no so nkonim.

Monnnɔ wiase anaa nnoɔma a ɛwɔ wiase. Sɛ obi dɔ wiase a, Agya no dɔ no nni ne mu. Na deɛ ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa, honam akɔnnɔ ne aniwa akɔnnɔ ne asetena mu ahohoahoa, ɛmfiri Agya no, na mmom ɛfiri wiase. Na wiase ne n’akɔnnɔ retwam, na deɛ ɔyɛ adeɛ a Onyankopɔn pɛ no tena hɔ daa.

Mmɔfra nkumaa, ɛdɔn a ɛdi akyire nie. Na sɛdeɛ moate sɛ antikristo no rebɛba no, saa na seesei yi antikristo bebree aba; ɛnna yɛde hunu sɛ dɔn a ɛdi akyire nie. Wɔfiri yɛn mu na ɛkɔeɛ deɛ, nanso wɔnka yɛn ho, na sɛ wɔka yɛn ho a, anka wɔne yɛn tenaa hɔ. Na ɛyɛɛ saa na wɔada adi sɛ wɔn nyinaa nka yɛn ho. Na mo deɛ, moanya ngosra no firi Ɔkronkronni no hɔ, na mo nyinaa nim de. Mantwerɛ mammrɛ mo sɛdeɛ monnim nokorɛ no, na mmom sɛ monim, ne sɛ atorɔ biara mfiri nokorɛ no mu.
Hwan ne ɔtorofoɔ no sɛ deɛ ɔsane sɛ Yesu nyɛ Kristo no? Oyi ne antikristo a ɔpo Agya no ne Ɔba no. Obiara a ɔpo Ɔba no, ɔnni Agya no nso, na deɛ ɔpae mu bɔ Ɔba no din no, wɔ Agya no nso. Enti mo deɛ, deɛ mote firii mfitiaseɛ no, momma no ntena mo mu; na sɛ deɛ mote firii mfitiaseɛ no tena mo mu a, ɛnneɛ mo nso mobɛtena Ɔba no ne Agya no mu. Na ɛbɔ a ɔde ahyɛ yɛn ne daa nkwa no.
Deɛ matwerɛ mabrɛ mo yi fa wɔn a wɔdaadaa mo no ho. Na mo deɛ, ngosra a monyaa no ne nsa mu no te mo mu, enti ɛnhia mo sɛ obi kyerɛkyerɛ mo; na mmom sɛdeɛ ngosra no ara kyerɛkyerɛ mo ade nyinaa ho no na ɛyɛ nokorɛ, na ɛnyɛ atorɔ. Na sɛdeɛ akyerɛkyerɛ mo no, montena ne mu! Na afei, mma nkumaa, montena ne mu, na sɛ oyi ne ho adi a, yɛanya awerɛhyɛmu, na yɛn ani anwu n’anim, ne ba mu.

Sɛ monim sɛ ɔyɛ ɔteneneeni a, anka mobɛhunu sɛ obiara a ɔyɛ ade tenenee no, ɔno na Onyankopɔn awo no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
